zoom-vp:zoom.description: Zoom the viewpoint to this element when its fragment turn comes.

zoom-vp:fragment.description: Reveal an element and zoom the viewpoint to it in one step.

zoom-vp:to.description: Zoom the viewpoint to another element by CSS selector.

zoom-vp:rect.description: Zoom the viewpoint to an explicit rectangle in slide coordinates.

zoom-vp:reset.description: Zoom the viewpoint back out to the full slide.
